description: This file defines the API and data structures for the Bluetooth Mesh BLOB Transfer Client model, including target node management, transfer capabilities, transfer states, event callbacks, and function prototypes for controlling BLOB transfers within the Zephyr project.

methods.name: bt_mesh_blob_cli_caps_get
methods.description: Retrieves transfer capabilities for a list of target nodes, invoking the caps callback upon completion.

methods.name: bt_mesh_blob_cli_send
methods.description: Starts a BLOB transfer to target nodes with specified transfer parameters and I/O stream.

methods.name: bt_mesh_blob_cli_xfer_progress_get
methods.description: Gets the progress of the BLOB transfer.

methods.name: bt_mesh_blob_cli_xfer_progress_active_get
methods.description: Returns the current progress percentage of the active transfer.

methods.name: bt_mesh_blob_cli_is_busy
methods.description: Checks if the BLOB client is currently participating in a transfer or retrieving capabilities.
